# AKANARA — Digital Studio in Bali

> Akanara (legal name: CV Akanara Digital Solutions) is a founder-led digital
> studio based in Bali, Indonesia, working with clients worldwide. We design and
> build websites, web apps and custom software, and drive growth through SEO,
> performance marketing and branding.

## Services

- Web Design & Development — editorial, motion-led, high-performance websites.
- Web Apps & Custom Software — dashboards, platforms, booking and commerce systems.
- Performance Marketing — Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and conversion tracking.
- Branding & Creative Direction — identity systems, art direction, guidelines.
- SEO · SEM · GEO — technical SEO, paid search, and generative-engine optimization.
